note: far core and outer lots, outside the 12 cells: five petrol stations whose OSM names are retired brands (same family as c3 昭和シェル -> apollostation). The bbox spans the five lots (田中前 -878,1478; 気仙沼バイパス 459,4671; 唐桑 5355,374 and 6432,142; ENEOS -2373,-206); only those five lots are patched. Idemitsu absorbed Showa Shell in 2019 and relabelled every Idemitsu and Shell station apollostation (rollout 2021-04, complete end of 2023). Esso became ENEOS. The OSM POIs that carry the old names are dropped by build-layout extras() because their lot is renamed; the lot name puts the new place in search and labels.
